response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"Poem, stanza 2","severity":"major","source_quote":"I’ll plan not for a life / That I might live in ease, / But only for today to live / My God alone to please.","suggested_fix":"Replace “Sitapanga maisha / Ambayo huenda nikaishi kwa raha, / Bali nitajitahidi kuishi leo / Ili kumpendeza Mungu wangu peke yake.” with “Sitaweka mipango ya maisha / Ambayo huenda nikaishi kwa raha, / Bali nitaishi kwa ajili ya leo tu / Ili kumpendeza Mungu wangu peke yake.”","translation_quote":"Sitapanga maisha / Ambayo huenda nikaishi kwa raha, / Bali nitajitahidi kuishi leo / Ili kumpendeza Mungu wangu peke yake."},{"location":"Poem, stanza 3","severity":"major","source_quote":"Nor dare I think in years / Or move from leaps to bounds;
